**Topics:** onshore wind · renewable energy · environmental & social impact assessment

## Overview

Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) for the **Alpha and Beta Onshore Wind Power Projects** in Vietnam, developed by **EDF Renouvelables Group (France)**.

## My role

- Supervised environmental fieldwork across water, soil, air, noise and biodiversity
- Authored the **Environmental Baseline** chapter covering climatic, hydrological and topographical site conditions
- Authored ESIA/ESMP chapters on surface water, groundwater, air, noise and soil impacts
- Modelled **ambient noise, shadow flicker and visual amenity** using WindPro, R and GIS
